name: Candy Apple Burst
inspiration: Candy Apple Red metallic under stage lights: a near-black stage with a red-biased tint, chrome hardware, and the gold undercoat Fender sprayed beneath the candy. Sections shatter into particles and reassemble.

display.stack: 'Barlow Condensed', Bahnschrift, 'Arial Narrow', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
display.note: Condensed, tall, tight — chrome-logo energy, used only for headlines

body.note: Neutral carrier so the particles and red own the drama

utility.stack: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, Menlo, monospace

motion.note: On section change the outgoing headline is rasterized to an offscreen canvas and exploded into particles; the swarm drifts, then converges to paint the incoming headline while the body content crossfades up. Canvas sits behind the DOM; GSAP drives swarm timing and DOM choreography from one timeline.
